column1: # AQL Language Specification: the aql:struct module
# Format: input<TAB>expected<TAB>description
# Loadable module of voxgig-struct data-manipulation utilities. These
# words were moved out of the core registry; they are reached only after
# `import`, under the `Struct` namespace: `import "aql:struct-util"
# StructUtil.word args`.
# §1  merge — deep, index-wise merge (later argument wins)
import "aql:struct-util" StructUtil.merge {a:1 b:2} {b:3 c:4}
import "aql:struct-util" StructUtil.merge {a:{x:1 y:2}} {a:{y:3 z:4}}
# §2  getpath — read a dotted path
import "aql:struct-util" StructUtil.getpath "a.b" {a:{b:42}}
import "aql:struct-util" StructUtil.getpath "name" {name:'Alice'}
# §3  setpath — write at a path (returns a new structure)
import "aql:struct-util" StructUtil.setpath {a:1} "b" 99
import "aql:struct-util" StructUtil.setpath {a:{b:1} c:2} "a.b" 99
column3: nested set keeps the outer wrapper + siblings

column1: import "aql:struct-util" StructUtil.setpath {a:1} "x.y" 5
column3: a nested path creates intermediate maps

column1: import "aql:struct-util" StructUtil.setpath {xs:[10 20 30]} "xs.1" 9
column3: a numeric segment indexes a list

column1: # §4  clone — deep copy (forward or stack form)
import "aql:struct-util" StructUtil.clone {a:1 b:2}
import "aql:struct-util" {a:1 b:2} StructUtil.clone
# §5  items — map entries as [key value] pairs
import "aql:struct-util" StructUtil.items {a:1 b:2}
# §6  validate — check data against a shape spec (returns the validated spec)
import "aql:struct-util" StructUtil.validate {name:"$STRING"} {name:'Alice'}
column3: conforming data validates against the spec

column1: # §7  transform — shape data via a spec (forward: spec then data)
import "aql:struct-util" StructUtil.transform {x:99} {a:'1'}
# §8  jsonify — serialise a value (also moved here; output verified in the
#     Go tests, the pretty-printed multiline form isn't tsv-expressible)
# §8b  nodify — project a value to its Node/Scalar form (pass-through when no
#      projection behavior is registered for the type)
import "aql:struct-util" StructUtil.nodify {a:1 b:2}
# §9  swap form dispatches through the namespace
import "aql:struct-util" {a:1} StructUtil.merge {b:2}
# §10  negative — unbound without import
StructUtil.merge {a:1} {b:2}
jsonify {a:1}
column3: jsonify also moved out of core

column1: # §11  inject — resolve backtick `$`-path references against a store
import "aql:struct-util" StructUtil.inject {greeting:'`name`'} {name:'Alice'}
# §12  selector — query-select children matching a spec
import "aql:struct-util" StructUtil.selector {color:'red'} {a:{color:'red'} b:{color:'blue'}}
# §13  walk — collect leaf path/value pairs
import "aql:struct-util" StructUtil.walk {a:1 b:{c:2}}
# §14  jsonify — serialise a value. Scalars render on one line (the
#      pretty-printed multiline form for maps/lists isn't tsv-expressible —
#      see §8 — so the Map output is verified in the Go tests).
import "aql:struct-util" StructUtil.jsonify 42
import "aql:struct-util" StructUtil.jsonify 'hi'
import "aql:struct-util" StructUtil.jsonify true
# §  reify — hydrate a class instance from JSON text or a Node; the
#    inverse of the instance-aware jsonify. Explicit class target (with
#    $class cross-check) or tor-union target ($class selects the
#    member, bounded to the union). Hydration routes through make:
#    defaults fill, required fields enforced, predicates run, unknown
#    keys error. jsonify carries $class on class instances and escapes
#    user $-keys to $$ (spoof-proof round-trip).
import "aql:struct-util"  def Point class {x:1, y:2} def p (StructUtil.reify Point {x:9}) p typeof
column3: reify from a Node constructs a typed instance

column1: import "aql:struct-util"  def Point class {x:1, y:2} (StructUtil.reify Point {x:9}) dot y
import "aql:struct-util"  def Point class {x:1} (StructUtil.reify Point (StructUtil.jsonify (make Point {x:9}))) dot x
column3: full jsonify→reify round trip through JSON text

column1: import "aql:struct-util"  def Circle class {r:1.0} def Square class {side:1.0} def Shape (Circle tor Square) (StructUtil.reify Shape (StructUtil.jsonify (make Square {side:4.0}))) typeof
import "aql:struct-util"  def Circle class {r:1.0} def Square class {side:1.0} def Shape (Circle tor Square) StructUtil.reify Shape {r:2.0}
column3: a union target without $class is a loud error

column1: import "aql:struct-util"  def Point class {x:1} StructUtil.reify Point {z:5}
column3: an undeclared key errors (hydration is sealed construction)

column1: import "aql:struct-util"  def Radius (Float gte 0.0) def Circle class {r:Radius} StructUtil.reify Circle '{"r": -1.5}'
column3: predicate field types run during hydration

column1: import "aql:struct-util"  def Radius (Float gte 0.0) def Circle class {r:Radius} (StructUtil.reify Circle '{"r": 5}') dot r
column3: schema-driven recovery: a JSON integer lands as the Float the field declares

column1: import "aql:struct-util"  StructUtil.reify Integer {x:1}
import "aql:struct-util"  def P class {name:'x' note:none} (StructUtil.reify P (StructUtil.jsonify (make P {note:none}))) dot note
column3: JSON null hydrates as the CONCRETE none value (the exact jsonify→reify inverse), not the None type literal

column1: # §  struct words on class / Object instances — type-preserving.
#    clone gives a fresh instance of the same type (deq-equal,
#    eq-distinct); setpath round-trips through construction, so a
#    class edit runs the same strict schema checks as make and the
#    receiver is untouched; walk sees the field projection.
import "aql:struct-util"  def Point class {x:1, y:2} (StructUtil.clone (make Point {})) typeof
import "aql:struct-util"  def Point class {x:1} def p (make Point {}) (StructUtil.clone p) deq p
import "aql:struct-util"  def Point class {x:1} def p (make Point {}) (StructUtil.clone p) eq p
import "aql:struct-util"  def Point class {x:1, y:2} (StructUtil.setpath (make Point {}) "x" 9) typeof
column3: setpath on an instance returns a NEW instance

column1: import "aql:struct-util"  def Point class {x:1, y:2} (StructUtil.setpath (make Point {}) "x" 9) dot x
import "aql:struct-util"  def Point class {x:1} def p (make Point {}) def w (StructUtil.setpath p "x" 9) p dot x
import "aql:struct-util"  def Point class {x:1} StructUtil.setpath (make Point {}) "nope" 9
column3: a class edit re-makes: unknown fields stay loud

column1: import "aql:struct-util"  def Point class {x:1} StructUtil.setpath (make Point {}) "x" 'hi'
import "aql:struct-util"  (StructUtil.setpath (object {a:1}) "b" 2) typeof
column3: an open Object edit stays an Object

column1: import "aql:struct-util"  (StructUtil.setpath (object {a:1}) "b" 2) dot b
import "aql:struct-util"  def Point class {x:1} StructUtil.walk (make Point {})
column3: walk sees the instance's field projection

column1: # §  parse — jsonic/JSON text → data (the decode complement of
#    jsonify). DATA context: nothing evaluates; the jsonic superset is
#    accepted (unquoted keys, optional commas), so strict JSON parses
#    too. Malformed input raises [aql/parse_error].
import "aql:struct-util" StructUtil.parse "{a:1, b:[2,3]}"
column3: jsonic text decodes to a Map

column1: import "aql:struct-util" StructUtil.parse "[1, 2, 3]"
column3: a JSON array decodes to a List

column1: import "aql:struct-util" StructUtil.parse '{"a": 1}'
import "aql:struct-util" StructUtil.parse "{val:'if'}"
column3: data context — text stays a string, never a word

column1: import "aql:struct-util" StructUtil.parse (StructUtil.jsonify {a:1 b:[2 3]})
import "aql:struct-util" StructUtil.parse "{a:1]"
import "aql:struct-util" StructUtil.parse ""
column3: empty input raises (never a silent none)

column1: # §X  Floats serialize as JSON numbers, not strings (bloom report:
#     jsonify emitted "x": "1.5"), and reify keeps the fraction —
#     whole-valued JSON numbers still come back as Integers.
import "aql:struct-util"  import "aql:string-util"  StringUtil.contains '"x": 1.5' (StructUtil.jsonify {x:1.5})
column3: a Float field serializes as a bare JSON number

column1: import "aql:struct-util"  import "aql:string-util"  StringUtil.contains '"1.5"' (StructUtil.jsonify {x:1.5})
column3: and never as a quoted string

column1: def P class {x:0.0} import "aql:struct-util"  (StructUtil.reify P "{\"x\": 1.5}").x
column3: reify keeps the fraction (was truncated to Integer 1)

column1: def P class {n:0} import "aql:struct-util"  (StructUtil.reify P "{\"n\": 2}").n typeof
column3: whole-valued JSON numbers still reify as Integers
